analysis:
The only changed file is CHANGELOG.md: a v0.10.1 candidate section is added and the v0.10.0 heading is marked published. Documentation only, so no executable code, controls or configs change. I read the described behavior against the threat model and found no security regression introduced by this PR.

Release notes describe code changes that live in other files and were not supplied. Later passes should check those against these threat IDs:
- Desktop control API: loopback authentication, the desktop_account scoped login, and the LaunchAgent (TB-003, A-008). Notes claim authenticated loopback, a read-only session, and provider credentials never changed.
- ~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json: a stat-based (device, inode, size, mtime, ctime) skip of the weight hash at coordinator-mode start. Weakening full re-hash would touch T-012 and T-027. The owner-only record and the SHA-256 manifest verification during GLM load are the stated mitigations. An operator who can modify weights while preserving inode, mtime and ctime is a theoretical gap, but the supplied evidence is not enough to judge it.
- Autopilot downloads, adoption, holds and watchdog: operator-consented behavior, on by default for consented Macs, with a 50 GiB free-disk floor.
- Autopilot selected_models widened to up to 256 cached models: reward qualification on the coordinator side and model-hash verification, relevant to T-055 and T-027.
- Page-cache memory accounting: availability and DoS (T-016, T-029).
- JSON modes, forced tool choice and strict tools on GLM: fail-closed 422 with no content on invalid output, consistent with T-008's fail-closed stance.
- Nemotron media body bound raised from 8 to 40 MiB: a modest DoS surface, with memory reservation taken before decode.
- Logprobs refusal before reservation: reduces a consumer-triggered cooldown DoS (ADV-002).
- Page-cache drop after weight hashing: no confidentiality effect.

The rollout note that requires darkbloom-platform#411 is an external contract. Its effect is limited to availability and is unverified here. No prefix-cache (T-041) behavior changes in this file.
